experiment: P5f shared frozen-forward and lazy bounded-head execution
research_question: Can the frozen five-model P5e JNR-only attachment execute the base multi-task forward once and evaluate the small attachment head only for samples with at least one frozen MFT/VFT/ISRJ positive decision, while preserving dense-reference outputs and reducing measured end-to-end latency?
single_changed_axis: inference scheduling only: one shared frozen base forward plus union-positive lazy head evaluation replaces P5e's dense posterior/base double-forward plus dense head evaluation; weights, heads, thresholds, features, targets and attachment cells are unchanged

dense_reference.base_execution: collect frozen posterior then collect full base parameter output
dense_reference.head_execution: evaluate the frozen 64-hidden attachment on every sample
dense_reference.attachment: write only frozen positive MFT/VFT/ISRJ JNR cells

candidate_execution.base_execution: one frozen model(iq) forward returns logits and normalized all-12 parameters
candidate_execution.head_execution: evaluate only samples with any frozen positive among MFT/VFT/ISRJ; scatter results only to their corresponding frozen positive cells
candidate_execution.shared_features: analytic physical features are collected once per identity/power view and reused across all five frozen model evaluations
candidate_execution.not_an_architecture_claim: this tests execution sharing, not a newly trained shared-backbone architecture

development_data.roles: evaluation-only; no training, selection, calibration or threshold adjustment

benchmark.device: same CUDA device, fixed batch size 126, inference_mode
benchmark.timing: CUDA synchronize before and after every timed repeat; report median, P10, P90 and dense/candidate ratio

stop_rule: If any equivalence or latency gate fails, retain P5e only as dense bounded-attachment evidence. Do not alter batch size, threshold, head, feature, timing loop, or scheduling on P5f development identities, and do not generate/use confirmation identities.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only a pass may support a narrow execution-feasibility claim; it still does not prove a new trained shared-backbone architecture.
